reviewer: chatgpt:Codex direct review with Astra visual review

findings.description: V10 crouch and sit renders still show the gray body through the white shorts up across both upper thighs; the under-shorts do not retain hip-flexion coverage. Neutral still shows a narrow center gap.
V10 back, crouch and sit renders still show two long pointed rear strips below the seat. The signed alternating pleat rails did not stabilize the rear hem into controlled folds.
V10 neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders retain broad faceted wrinkles and pinched folds around sleeves, underarms and jacket waist.
V10 render shows decorative diagonal placket details but no retained fastening mechanism is defined or evidenced. Closure security and fit remain unverified.

nextAction: Keep V10 rejected and release blocked. Change the shorts to an integrated, sewn crotch/gusset topology that provides additional hip-flexion coverage, replace the overskirt fold seed with a supported panel/pleat construction that removes both rear tails, smooth the jacket panel assembly, and add a retained fastening. Generate and directly inspect a new 3D render before acceptance. UV remains NOT_CREATED; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain UNVERIFIED.
